about: EBI Search (EMBL-EBI): keyword search across all EMBL-EBI data resources such as UniProt, PDBe, Ensembl, Europe PMC, ChEBI and Reactome, with entry lookup, cross-references, gene/protein identification and FASTA sequence download.

commands.summary: Keyword search within one EBI Search domain (e.g. uniprot, proteinSequences, pubmed, chebi, pdbe), with field selection, facet filters, sorting and offset paging

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain id, e.g. uniprot, proteinSequences, pubmed, chebi, pdbe, ensembl_gene, reactome, allebi. Run list-domains for all ids.

params.name: query
params.description: Lucene-style query, e.g. insulin, or field:value such as name:insulin AND TAXONOMY:9606

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Comma-separated retrievable fields to return for each entry. Valid fields depend on the domain (see get-domain-info). uniprot example: descRecName,organism_scientific_name,acc,status. Sent to the site

params.name: facets
params.description: Facet filters as facetId:value, comma-separated, e.g. TAXONOMY:9606,status:Reviewed (see get-search-facets for values)

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort as field:ascending|descending, e.g. publication_date:descending. Only sortable fields are allowed (see get-domain-info); uniprot does not allow sorting on id or length.

params.name: size
params.description: Results per page (max 100)

params.name: start
params.description: Zero-based result offset for paging

commands.summary: Get facet value counts for a query in a domain, e.g. source database, organism (TAXONOMY) or review status, to discover filter values for search-domain

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain id, e.g. uniprot, proteinSequences, pubmed

params.name: query
params.description: Search query

params.name: facetfields
params.description: Comma-separated facet ids to return, e.g. domain_source, TAXONOMY, status. Omit to get all facets.

params.name: facetcount
params.description: Maximum number of values per facet

params.name: facets
params.description: Facet filters already applied, e.g. TAXONOMY:9606

commands.summary: Search all EMBL-EBI data at once and get hit counts per domain and subdomain (the tree behind the 'All results' page)

params.name: query
params.description: Keyword query

commands.summary: List all EBI Search domains and subdomains (ids, names, descriptions, index info) as a tree
Get one domain's metadata: searchable/retrievable/sortable fields, facets, and index info. Use it to find valid values for fields, facets and sort.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain id, e.g. uniprot, pubmed, pdbe

commands.summary: Fetch one or more entries by id or accession from a domain, with selected fields

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain id, e.g. uniprot

params.name: ids
params.description: Entry id(s), comma-separated, e.g. P01308 or P06213,P08069

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Comma-separated retrievable fields for the domain, e.g. descRecName,organism_scientific_name,status,length (sent to the site as "fields"; clify's own --fields only shapes the output)

params.name: fieldurl
params.description: Include links to the source resource page

params.name: viewurl
params.description: Include alternative view links such as FASTA

commands.summary: List the domains an entry is cross-referenced to, with the number of referenced entries in each (e.g. pdbe, alphafold, europepmc)

params.name: domain
params.description: Source domain id, e.g. uniprot, omim, reactome, hgnc

params.name: id
params.description: Entry id in the source domain, e.g. INS_HUMAN or P01308 for uniprot, 176730 for omim

commands.summary: Get the entries in a target domain that cross-reference a given entry (e.g. AlphaFold or BioModels entries for UniProt INS_HUMAN)

params.name: domain
params.description: Source domain id, e.g. uniprot

params.name: id
params.description: Entry id(s) in the source domain, comma-separated, e.g. INS_HUMAN or P01308

params.name: targetDomain
params.description: Target domain id taken from list-entry-xref-domains for this entry (only those with referenceEntryCount > 0 return results), e.g. alphafold, biomodels, complex-portal, europepmc

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Comma-separated retrievable fields of the target domain to return, e.g. name,description. Sent to the site as "fields"; clify's own --fields only shapes the output.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of references per page (max 100)

params.name: start
params.description: Zero-based offset into the references

commands.summary: Identify what a search term refers to (gene, protein, etc., grouped by orthology and organism) with links to summary pages

params.name: term
params.description: Gene or protein name or symbol, e.g. insulin, INS, INSR, IDE

commands.summary: Get the gene/protein summary details (expression, structures, literature...) for an identification returned by identify-term

params.name: term
params.description: The original search term

params.name: spine
params.description: Spine id from identify-term, e.g. molecular

params.name: tid
params.description: Identification id (iid) from identify-term, e.g. synENSG00000144749

params.name: classification
params.description: NCBI taxonomy id of the organism, e.g. 9606 for human

commands.summary: Download raw database entries such as a FASTA sequence via dbfetch (e.g. UniProtKB P01308 in FASTA)

params.name: id
params.description: Accession(s), comma-separated, e.g. P01308

params.name: db
params.description: dbfetch database name

params.name: format
params.description: Output format; available formats depend on the database
